visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A female doctor with short, layered brown hair and glasses is shown from the side, speaking actively. She wears a black blouse with lace detailing. The background is a clean, modern office with a computer screen displaying a face and a lamp with a black shade. (2) A close-up of a patient's face is displayed. Graphical overlays include red circles with minus signs on the cheeks and jawline, and green circles with plus signs appearing near the nose and chin to illustrate facial volume changes over time. (3) The doctor returns to the screen, gesturing with her hands as she continues her explanation. The lighting is bright and professional, typical of a clinical office environment. (4) Split-screen 'Before' and 'After' comparisons of the patient's face are shown. Red and yellow semi-transparent ellipses highlight the nasolabial folds and lip area, demonstrating the subtle filling effects of aesthetic treatments. (5) A final close-up of the doctor's face as she delivers a concluding remark. (6) A transition to a white background featuring the 'DRX DERMATOLOGY CLINIC' logo and contact information including a phone number, address, and QR code markers.

(5) [Subtitle]: 我們要拿機器起來 把這個地方做減法. (6) [Subtitle]: 美國音波要這樣打. (7) [Subtitle]: 填充物又不能打到太飽 我們就只能補一點點 讓他比較順一點~. (8) [Variety]: Before. After. [Subtitle]: 不要凹的這麼厲害 但是還是要維持原有的凹陷.
